items.title: Andhra man unleashes savage chainsaw attack on teen girl and friend inside classroom, arrested
items.summary: A 21-year-old man has been arrested for the horrific power chainsaw attack on a 14-year-old student in Andhra Pradesh’s Anantapur district. The accused, identified as Hemanth, was arrested near Dharmavaram Railway station on Saturday, October 31, in the afternoon, a few hours after he attacked a girl’s face, neck and torso with a power chainsaw in Raptadu mandal. The tenth-grade student, identified as Gopika, was attacked by Hemanth inside a Zilla Parishad High School classroom in Raptadu as class was in session. The victim suffered critical injuries to her head, neck and back, while her classmate, Lakshmi, who tried to intervene, was also injured in the process. A horrified Lakshmi told the media, "It happened around 10.30 am. He turned on the chainsaw and entered the classroom. He attacked [Gopika] in front of the teacher. Then he attacked me in the leg. She collapsed right there. All the students went out of the classroom. He took the chainsaw and escaped on his bike. The teacher also saw the chainsaw and got scared. He came alone.
